🐶 NEW: Researchers in #Budapest recorded #EEG from 14 dogs that were either obeying a stop command or resting quietly.

When the #dogs held themselves back, their #brains produced theta wave activity matching the frequency and location of human self-control signals, suggesting dogs may suppress behavior deliberately rather than automatically.

👉 https://phys.org/news/2026-09-dogs-human-brain-restrain.html
